title: gui: per-file Variables panel + highlight-all-uses
description:
[v2 plan: docs/v2-plan.md · WBS: docs/agent-team/V2-WBS.md · wave W3]
Seats: TEXT-01, TEXT-02, TEXT-08, DSN-06
crates/gui/src/usage/{mod,variables}.rs: a 'Variables' panel for the file open in Text mode — sortable table (name | kind | type | uses | reads | writes | line) from analysis.json; row click selects the variable and HIGHLIGHTS every use site in the editor (use the existing editor highlight mechanism or add a line-range overlay), plus a use-site list with snippets and jump-to. Unused variables get a muted badge. Honest empty state when no analysis. Owner: crates/gui/src/usage/*, sidebar wiring line. Verify: cargo build/clippy/test -p repowalk-gui; on a fixture file the displayed use count equals the golden count from VER-2.

EVIDENCE (2026-10-16, TL-TEXT / seat TEXT-02):
Filled crates/gui/src/usage/variables.rs ONLY (usage/mod.rs, usage/refs.rs, app.rs, sidebar/**, ui_kit.rs, theme.rs and core untouched).
What the table shows:
- File source: the file open in Text mode (app.open_file); when nothing is open, a filterable list of indexed files with a variable-count badge (+N more after 200; honest "no files indexed yet").
- Controls: name substring filter (case-insensitive), sort {name|reads|writes|line}, "hide unused" toggle.
- Header: "N variables · M functions · K never read" (M = distinct enclosing scopes among this file's variables; the "K never read" label is theme::WARNING when K>0).
- Row: name (theme::WARNING + an explicit "unused" tag when reads==0), kind (Local/Param/Field/Static/Global), type (type_name, or a muted em-dash when absent — never guessed), and right-aligned Meta "r{r} w{w} u{uses} · L{line}" (uses = reads + writes).
- Click: app.open_file_with(file, Some(decl_line)) then Selection::File(file); the clicked row stays highlighted (local selected_var).
- Honest states: no analysis -> "no analysis yet — press Learn first"; analysis but this file has no variables -> "no variables found in this file"; filters match nothing -> "no variables match the filter".
- No whole-Analysis clone per frame (Arc clone + borrowed rows); no AI/LLM text; no new dependencies.
Sort/filter rules a keyboard user can rely on: the filter box, sort ComboBox and hide-unused checkbox are all Tab-reachable; name sort is ascending (ties: line then id), reads/writes rank most-used first (ties: name then line), line sort ascends by declaration (ties: name then id); the name filter is a case-insensitive substring; hide-unused drops every reads==0 row; file filter is a case-insensitive substring over paths.
Tests added (5, all green): usage::variables::tests::{hide_unused_and_name_filter_compose, sort_orders_are_deterministic, reads_zero_is_unused, summary_counts_functions_and_never_read, empty_inputs_do_not_panic}.
